content.short: Wyre is an exchange offering crypto-to-fiat and compliance solutions via API and dashboard.
content.description: Wyre delivers crypto-to-fiat exchange capabilities and compliance tooling through an API and a dashboard. Since 2013, Wyre has built infrastructure to bridge traditional payment processing rails with digital assets, enabling smoother value movement between fiat currencies and tokens. The platform serves individuals, businesses and enterprises via an API for crypto exchanges and cross-border payments, a concierge over-the-counter desk, and on-chain compliance solutions designed to support regulatory requirements for crypto activity.
content.meta: Wyre provides crypto-to-fiat exchange and compliance via API. Discover Wyre and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
